Explainer storyboard

How to use CrowdPulse

A 4:17 walkthrough, from creating a session to the report. Every image is a real frame of the render (from the 1440p master, shown at 1280×720), and the narration is the script the Kokoro af_heart voice reads. Scenes and camera moves come from film/studio/director.js.

0:00Cold open

Shows
The landing page and its live demo phone
Camera
Starts tight on the demo gauge, pulls back to reveal the page
Sound
Music swells in; whoosh on the title

0:00This is CrowdPulse. It lets your audience rate your session while it’s happening, so you can feel the room, live.

0:07Here’s how it works, from creating a session to the report at the end.

0:12Create a session

Shows
Host dashboard: the new-session form, location modes, features and the QR code it makes
Camera
Zooms on each field as it is filled, then on the QR code and join code
Sound
Key taps while typing, clicks, chime on the QR reveal

0:12Start in the host dashboard. Give your session a title, a short description, and your name.

0:18Pick a date and time, then say where it’s happening: in person, virtual, or hybrid, with a venue and a meeting link.

0:26Choose an accent colour, switch on the features you want, list it on the home page if you like, and create it.

0:32You instantly get a QR code and a six-character join code.

0:37Invite the room

Shows
Stage view lobby: giant QR code, join code and avatars appearing as people join
Camera
Starts on the QR code, pulls back to the room filling up
Sound
Soft pops as avatars arrive

0:37Put the stage view up on the projector. It shows a giant QR code, and avatars pop in as people join.

0:45Join from any phone

Shows
The home page Happening now list; attendee joins with the code, picks a profile, waits in the lobby countdown
Camera
Phone on the right, story on the left; zooms on the Happening now list, the code boxes and the countdown
Sound
Key taps, clicks

0:45If you listed it, your session shows up on the home page, under Happening now, so people can find it without a code.

0:52Or they just scan the QR code, or type it in. There’s no app to install, and no sign-up.

0:59They choose a name, an avatar and a colour, then wait in the lobby, where a countdown ticks down to the start.

1:05Go live

Shows
Control room Go live button; every phone switches to rating
Camera
Control room and phone side by side; zoom on the button, then on the phone
Sound
Click, confetti burst

1:06When you’re ready, open the control room and press Go live.

1:10Every phone switches to rating mode right away.

1:13Rate your way

Shows
All nine rating styles, including tilting the phone, each mapped to the same 0–100 score
Camera
Phone close-up; the list on the left lights up for each style
Sound
Clicks and taps

1:13Rating takes a second. The slider is the default: drag it, and the face changes with you.

1:20But everyone can pick the style they like best. Smileys.

1:24Stars.

1:26A rotary dial.

1:28The weather in your head.

1:30A thermometer of hype.

1:33Thumbs, tapped to nudge it up or down.

1:36Or a ring of vibes.

1:38Or just tilt your phone, like a spirit level, and tap Hold when it feels right.

1:44Whatever the style, it all becomes one score, from zero to a hundred.

1:48Reaction storms

Shows
Emoji reactions from phones float across every screen, including the stage view
Camera
Stage view full screen with the phone picture-in-picture; zoom on the reaction bar
Sound
Taps and pops

1:49Tap a reaction, and it floats up on every screen, including the big one.

1:54Chat, Q&A and polls

Shows
Live chat, Q&A with upvotes, quick polls from the control room, spotlighted questions
Camera
Phone close-ups, then control room and phone side by side
Sound
Key taps, clicks

1:55There’s a live chat, so the room can talk to each other.

1:58Questions go to the Q and A, where the room upvotes the best ones.

2:03From the control room, you can launch a quick poll in two clicks.

2:07And you can put the top question in the spotlight, on every screen.

2:12Read the room

Shows
Control room telemetry: gauge, distribution, KPIs, chapter markers, mood chart and the presenter coach
Camera
Control room full; zooms on the gauge, KPIs, the chart and the coach alert
Sound
Clicks

2:12Meanwhile, the control room shows you how it’s going, every second: the crowd’s mood, how the ratings are spread, energy, and trend.

2:21Drop chapter markers as you move through your talk, so later you can see which parts landed.

2:27And a built-in coach nudges you when the mood dips, or spikes.

2:32Passive signals

Shows
Tab focus, the opt-in attendee camera and its consent sheet, the control room Passive signals card, said vs. shown, and the distracted coach nudge
Camera
Phone close-up on the consent sheet, then the control room card, the said-vs-shown meters, the coach alert and the dashed attention line
Sound
Clicks

2:32CrowdPulse can also read the room passively. When the host allows it, attendees can choose to share their attention.

2:40Their camera is analysed on their own phone. No video ever leaves it: just three numbers, for attention, positive, and fatigue.

2:49In the control room, the passive signals card blends tab focus, cameras and a room sensor into one attention index, shown only once five or more people take part.

3:00It also compares what people say with what they show. When ratings stay high but attention slips, the coach flags it: polite, but distracted.

3:10On the big screen

Shows
Stage view during the session: gauge, stats, chat ticker, chart and reactions
Camera
Slow push-in on the gauge, then wide
Sound
Confetti burst

3:10The stage view puts it all up on the projector: the live gauge, the chat, the polls, and every single reaction.

3:17Wrap up

Shows
End the session; the attendee feedback form: stars, NPS, detail ratings and one word
Camera
Side by side, then close on the phone form
Sound
Clicks, key taps, confetti

3:18When you finish, end the session. Every phone asks for a quick review: stars, how likely they are to recommend it, and one word that sums it up.

3:27The report

Shows
Post-session report: grade, KPIs, timeline, insights, key moments, engagement, word cloud, NPS and exports
Camera
Zooms on the grade, then scrolls with push-ins on each section
Sound
Chime on the grade

3:27Then comes the report. A grade, a score, and the numbers that matter.

3:32The mood timeline shows every chapter, and key moments pick out the biggest peaks and dips, with what people were saying at the time.

3:41A passive signals section lines attention up against the ratings, and finds where they disagreed: engaged but critical in the deep dive, and polite but distracted during the results.

3:53Then engagement, reactions, sentiment, a word cloud, and the Net Promoter Score.

4:02Export it as a PDF, a CSV or JSON, and share it with your audience if you like.

Shows
End card: how to start it
Camera
Wide on the landing page under the end card
Sound

4:09That’s CrowdPulse. Run npm start, open the host dashboard, and feel the room. Live.
